cover.headline: 14 stories in 5 minutes. Vance sees progress in Iran talks, the US votes, Netanyahu's camp calls Israel's election stolen.

stories.head: Vance sees progress; Tehran says the ball is in US court
body: Iran says the US must lift its naval blockade and meet its demands in full. Two tankers caught fire after hitting sea mines in Hormuz, the Guard says.
Trump says the war ends very soon one way or the other. Stocks rose as oil fell on deal hopes.

stories.head: Kherson truce ends; alert apps hacked
body: The six-day local ceasefire near Oleshky expired Sunday. Ukraine's alert app then sent false nuclear warnings; Russia says its own app was hit too.
Ukraine says Russia fired 433 drones overnight. Emergency services say 24 died in a Zaporizhzhia village.

stories.head: US votes today; Israel's result disputed; Iotova ahead
body: US: control of Congress is at stake. Israel: officials say the result stands as Likud alleges a stolen vote without evidence.
Bulgaria: exit polls favor Iliana Iotova; challenger Gyurov conceded.

stories.head: Hebron siege lifted; Poland's court clash
body: Israeli forces left Hebron after 10 days. Local officials say 537 families were forced out. Sudan took drone complaints against Ethiopia to the UN.
Poland: the president and Tusk's government clash over the Constitutional Tribunal.

stories.head: Bangladesh wage protests; Florida jet crash
body: Garment workers demand 30,000 taka a month, up from 12,500. About 500 factories were shut and a wage board is formed.
A Learjet crash in Florida killed all nine aboard. Korea: inflation 2.8%.
